topics.description: Former FBI Director Robert Mueller, who led the Trump-Russia investigation, has died at 81. Mueller's investigation led to numerous high-profile convictions and guilty pleas.
topics.reason: Robert Mueller's death is trending due to his significant role in the Trump-Russia investigation and its lasting impact on American politics.
